fortification_effect_after_PassB_and_pre.heavy_coastal_system: many physical positions survive or remain repairable, but pre-GALVANIC south/west orientation limits direct utility against lagoon landing; no hindsight reorientation
fortification_effect_after_PassB_and_pre.Red_beach_direct_fire_positions: ~55-70% of pre-assigned weapon positions remain physically weapon-capable at H-hour; only ~45-60% can join a coordinated opening fire at once
fortification_effect_after_PassB_and_pre.tactical_comms: ~55-70% of critical local paths available through primary/alternate wire and runners at H-hour; degradation accelerates after firing reveals positions
fortification_effect_after_PassB_and_pre.forward_ammunition: ~70-85% of planned local ammunition remains accessible because small magazines/blast separation reduce chain loss
fortification_effect_after_PassB_and_pre.protected_personnel: forward crews and command cadres suffer fewer prelanding losses than v004 baseline; gain is survival/organization, not extra manpower
fortification_effect_after_PassB_and_pre.engineer_plant: some bombproof/revetment repair and debris-clearing capacity survives into D-day morning; tiny-island access remains severe ceiling

US_adaptive_prelanding_response.targeted_extension: ~15-25 minutes equivalent extra/retasked destroyer-cruiser/carrier precision fire against observed active positions, not a wholesale new bombardment day
US_adaptive_prelanding_response.effect: removes some newly surviving exposed firepoints, but cannot identify every covered weapon before it fires
US_adaptive_prelanding_response.cost: ammunition/time/spotting aircraft and deck cycles charged to the assault-support wallet

net_assessment: H-hour fire system is materially more coherent than v004, but still bounded by Betio geometry and wrong-side pre-GALVANIC defensive emphasis.
